subject: Branch edge silo onboarding schedule and migration credits
messages:
From: Stella Park <stella@shoreline.health>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: aneesh.kapoor@shoreline.health
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + additional siloing for APAC edge sites

Hi Hiro / Marissa,

Thanks for the call last week. As discussed, Shoreline is planning a renewal for our Redwood Private contract (current term ends 2027-02-28) and we want to: 1) carve out a new tenant/silo for our APAC branch analytics workload, 2) provision 4 additional inference clusters (edge-optimized) in the new tenant, and 3) add a burst reserve for peak processing windows.

We've attached a capacity_request.xlsx with current token throughput and expected growth (Q1 projection included). High level asks: 24-month extension on the renewed term, one-time migration credit to offset cutover costs, and an accelerated provisioning timeline (targeting production by end of Q1 2027).

Can you confirm the expected lead times, a rough estimate of one-time credits, and what compliance artifacts you need for the APAC sites? We're happy to sign an amendment if the economics and timelines line up.

Thanks,
Stella Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Shoreline Health

Attachment: capacity_request.xlsx (excel/stub)
From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Stella Park <stella@shoreline.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + additional siloing for APAC edge sites

Stella — thanks for the clear summary and the sheet. Short answers up front:
- Lead time: baseline provisioning for a new tenant + 4 edge clusters is ~7-9 weeks after signed amendment + network clearances; can compress to ~4-6 weeks with an approved burst reserve and pre-provisioned images.
- Migration credit: Sales will propose a one-time credit tied to committed ARR / signature timing (Marissa will share details).
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 snapshot, network diagram, and any IP allow-listing details for the on-prem connectors.

Couple of discovery items so we can prep ops:
1) Are the APAC clusters fully on-prem (air-gapped) or VPC-connected? (Sheet shows mixed.)
2) Expected 95th-percentile token/sec per cluster during peak windows.
3) Any regulatory constraints requiring data-at-rest not to leave region (this would affect snapshotting and backup config).

If you can confirm those, I'll loop in Priyom to draft a staging/provisioning calendar and Marissa to build the amendment. Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call week of Nov 8 to lock timelines.

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Draft commercial terms: APAC tenant + cluster add-on (REDW-3372)

Stella / Aneesh — following Hiro's note, attaching a draft term amendment and a ballpark cost/credit structure for review. Summary here: 

- Renewal: 24-month extension from ingestion of amendment (adds predictability for capacity).
- New tenant + 4 edge clusters: one-time onboarding fee (covers airgap prep & image distribution) + monthly dedicated cluster commit.
- Burst reserve: optional pre-purchased burst (covers 30 days of projected peak) that reduces provisioning lead time.
- Migration credit: proposed $15,000 one-time credit if amendment is countersigned by 2026-12-15 and Shoreline commits to the 24-month term.

Attachments: term_amendment_draft.pdf (pdf/stub), commercial_summary_redw3372.xlsx (excel/stub)

Open items: final network topology, SOC2 evidence for APAC auditors, and whether backups can be cross-region (you previously noted they should not leave APAC). If backups are restricted, we need to flag a small change to our backup agent config (ops impact: +2 days).

If the high-level looks OK, I'll prepare a redline and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. We can also itemize an expedited provisioning SOW (ops-runbook) if you want a guaranteed cutover date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: term_amendment_draft.pdf (pdf/stub)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, Stella Park <stella@shoreline.health>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft commercial terms: APAC tenant + cluster add-on (REDW-3372)

Stella / team —
Quick security checklist to keep things moving:
- Please share the APAC network diagram and firewall rules (we need to validate ports for the edge connectors). We've attached network_diagram_v2.png as a placeholder; can you confirm it's the current topology?
- SOC2: we can provide the snapshot (latest report) but auditors may request environment-level logs for the new tenant — that requires us to schedule a 2-hour access window for them or provide a redacted extract. Attached: soc2_snapshot.pdf (redacted stub).
- Key management: confirm if you want Redwood-managed KMS or a customer-managed KMS (HSM). HSM integrations add ~5 business days to provisioning.

Priyom, once Stella confirms topology I'll queue a provisioning runway and estimate blackout windows for cutover.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Stella Park <stella@shoreline.health>

Cc: aneesh.kapoor@shoreline.health, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Draft commercial terms: APAC tenant + cluster add-on (REDW-3372)

Thanks everyone — this looks good and aligns with our internal expectations. Confirming:
- Shoreline accepts the $15,000 migration credit conditional on countersign by 2026-12-15.
- APAC clusters will be VPC-connected (not fully air-gapped); backups must remain in APAC.
- We will provide the final network diagram and port list by Nov 18.

Please go ahead and prepare the DocuSign for the amendment and a proposed provisioning kickoff: Nov 29, 2026 (we've blocked the window). If you can include an ops SOW with blackout windows and the 4-cluster prebuild checklist in the DocuSign package, that would help our procurement team review quickly.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

-Stella
Head of Platform Engineering, Shoreline Health
